messages:
Ben (docs): Quick PR opened to update quota examples and embed new metering v2 snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/5488 — can folks sanity check the HTTP payload, SDK sample, and dashboard link?
Carmen (eng): Scanning. Don't use X-Usage-Plan header in new examples. Prefer JSON metering and mention X-Redwood-Usage as the SDK/header shim.
Ben (docs): Got it. I'll swap header example to JSON body and add a short note about the header shim.
Ravi (product): Also update the sample tier bands in the explanatory calc. Marketing adjusted Standard to 80k-650k. Add a parenthetical: (check pricing page for live bands).
Theo (devex): SDK snippet should use metering.submit() for parity with v3. Keep it tiny and copy-pastable.
Ben (docs): Updated SDK example to metering.submit({ customerId: "acct_246", items: [{ "completion.tokens": 135000 }] }). Also changed HTTP block to JSON and set code block languages appropriately.
Carmen (eng): Payload looks fine. Remove the stray comma after the customerId and prefer ISO timestamps.
Ben (docs): Fixed comma and timestamp. Also replaced old Grafana link with https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/overview?panelId=21 and added alt text: "Panel: daily tokens by tier".
Ravi (product): Migration blurb request: short line "If you used X-Usage-Plan, migrate to JSON metering or X-Redwood-Usage; unit calculations unchanged."
Ben (docs): Added migration sentence and a tiny diff snippet w/ old vs new.
preview-bot: Preview build created for PR 5488 11 https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/5488 (build 853).
Carmen (eng): LGTM from Eng, just ensure l10n keys for the caption are present.
Ravi (product): Product approves. Merge in ~10m unless objections.
Ben (docs): Thanks all 389 merging shortly.
